context.body: Prophets, judges, kings, households, and assemblies pray while public events keep moving around them. The bounded source is 2 Chronicles 20:1–30.

observations.body: A threatened assembly seeks the LORD.

observations.body: Jehoshaphat prays, a Levite speaks, singers go out, and the battle outcome follows.

payload.posture: Read 2 Chronicles 20:1–30 as prayer inside israel’s story evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: Prayer does not end the scene: a Spirit-given speech, worship, consultation, singers, enemy action, gathering spoil, and return all follow.
